title: MSFS Marketplace Update (PC) — Tropical NCRG Rarotonga + KPSM Portsmouth! 🌴✈️
description:
On March 14, 2026, the MSFS Marketplace Update for PC is packed with “must‑have” add-ons from this week’s table — and while this specific video focuses on new airports & sceneries (no new aircraft listed in this PC airports/scenery set), there are some really tempting pickups here for island hopping, regional ops, and night flying vibes.

✈️ New airports added this week (PC)
The following airports were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🛫 UK2000 Scenery: KPSM Portsmouth Airport (Great pick for regional ops and GA in the northeast US)
🛫 KiwiFlightSim: NCRG Rarotonga International, Cook Islands (Tropical island gateway — perfect for scenic approaches)
🛫 KIWIFLIGHTSIM: NZHK Hokitika Airport (Awesome for New Zealand regional routes and rugged coastal flying)

🌆 New sceneries added this week (PC)
The following sceneries were newly released in the marketplace this week:

🌆 dfflyerdirect: Detroit Midtown (A nice city detail boost for low-and-slow and skyline passes)
🌆 Burning Blue Design: United Kingdom Solar (Great VFR landmark enhancement across the UK)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Detroit Region Enhanced Road Lights (Night flying immersion boost)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Dover Region Enhanced Road Lights (Cleaner night routes and highway visibility)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Dublin Region Enhanced Road Lights (Adds extra pop for night approaches and city hops)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Glasgow Region Enhanced Road Lights (Big help for nighttime VFR references)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Hartford Region Enhanced Road Lights (More definition for after-dark flying)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Hong Kong Region Enhanced Road Lights (A dramatic upgrade for night city flying)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Honolulu Region Enhanced Road Lights (Island nights look so much better with enhanced roads)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Houston Region Enhanced Road Lights (Perfect for urban night ops)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Indianapolis Region Enhanced Road Lights (Sharper nighttime navigation cues)
🌆 Dreamscenery: Istanbul Region Enhanced Road Lights (Adds that mega-city glow on night departures/arrivals)
If you enjoyed the update, smash that 👍, hit Subscribe for the weekly Marketplace rundowns, and drop a comment telling me which airport or scenery you’re grabbing (or skipping) this week!
Thanks for watching and happy flying
✈️ See you in the skies!
